data.name: Adelbert
data.gender_notes: Adelbert is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Adelbert is a Germanic name derived from Old High German 'adal' meaning noble and 'berht' meaning bright. This name was popular among Germanic tribes and was brought to England by the Anglo-Saxons. It was also used by the early Christians in Europe. The name Adelbert carries the meaning “Noble and bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adelbert usually hope their child will grow to embody noble and bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the inner light and nobility of the soul.
data.etymology: Adelbert belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble and bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adelbert total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: עדלברט
in_hebrew.meaning: אדלברט: עדל = חסר, לברט = חזק, חסר-חזק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עדלברט: עדל הוא חסר, לברט הוא חזק, יצירת שם שמעודד חסרונות וחזקות. השם עדלברט נזכר כשמו של קדוש, ומסמל את הערך של האדם חסר-חזק. בברית החדשה, השם עדלברט לא נזכר, אך הוא חלק מהמסורת הנוצרית. בתרבות הנוצרית, השם עדלברט סמל לחסרונות וחזקות, ומשמש כשם לבני אדם שרואים בעצמם חסר-חזק.

in_greek.name: Ἀδελβέρτος
in_greek.meaning: Ἀδελβέρτος: ἀδελ- = ἀδελφός, βέρτος = βάρβαρος, ἀδελφός-βάρβαρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἀδελβέρτος: Ἀδελβέρτος הוא שם מלכותי, שנוצר על ידי ברבריזציה של שם מקדש, Adelbertus. השם Ἀδελβέρτος נזכר כשמו של קדוש, ומייצג את הערך של האדם החסר-חזק. בברית החדשה, השם Ἀδελβέρτος לא נזכר, אך הוא חלק מהמסורת הנוצרית. בתרבות הנוצרית, השם Ἀδελβέρτος סמל לחסרונות וחזקות, ומשמש כשם לבני אדם שרואים בעצמם חסר-חזק.

in_latin.name: Adelbertus
in_latin.meaning: Adelbertus: Adel- = amicus, Ber- = fortis, Adel- + Ber- = amicus fortis
in_latin.long_meaning: Adelbertus: Adelbertus est nomen gentilitium, quod creatus est per barbarizatio nominis sacerdotis, Adelbertus. Nomen Adelbertus nomen sancti memoratur, et repraesentat virtutem hominis, qui est amicus fortis. In Novo Testamento, nomen Adelbertus non mentionatur, sed est pars historiae Christianae. In cultura Christiana, nomen Adelbertus symbolum est virtutis amici fortis, et utitur nomen ad homines, qui se amici fortis putant.

in_english.name: Adelbert
in_english.meaning: Adelbert: Adel- = friend, Ber- = strong, friend-strong
in_english.long_meaning: Adelbert: Adelbert is a surname that originated from the Germanic name Adalbert, which means 'noble bright' or 'friend-strong'. The name Adelbert is associated with Saint Adelbert, a 7th-century bishop and martyr. In Christian tradition, Adelbert symbolizes the value of being a strong friend and a noble person. The name Adelbert is also associated with the Germanic tribe of the Abodrites, who lived in present-day Germany and Denmark. In modern times, the name Adelbert is used in various Christian cultures to signify the importance of friendship and strength.
